core: Existing ERS Linux and ERS-W Windows framework remains the controlled-lab experimental foundation
status: Design proposal; no new runtime analysis, training or evaluation completed
research_question: Can a classifier infer actual controlled assessment outcomes from incomplete operator observations better than explicit rules on held-out lab machines?
novelty: Candidate contribution requiring broader literature review and measured evidence
unit: One predeclared harmless task episode within a session

output.confidence: Finite [0,1] or null when no prediction
output.evidence: References must exist within the input task window

ground_truth: Separately recorded and reviewed synthetic endpoint completion/failure and expected output-receipt evidence
model_authority: Read-only; no execution, routing, reconnect or listener-control actions
splits: Group sessions and duplicates; hold out machines and collection periods; report each OS
information_limit: Identical permitted observations may not distinguish different actual outcomes; abstain rather than assert certainty
